title: SDK docs quick fixes + sample apps scratchpad
body:
Morning brain dump (quick, noisy)

2026-03-11 morning sprint-in-my-head: chunking out small tasks I can finish before EOD. Focus: docs surface area (JS + Python SDK), 2 sample apps, and a tutorial fix that keeps cropping up in support tickets.

Top priorities (short):
1) Quick copy edits for 'retry/backoff' section in JS SDK README - examples inaccurate for streaming errors.
   - Problem: snippet shows single .catch() usage but streaming client emits 'error' event earlier.
   - Quick fix: add tiny code sample using client.on('error', ...) and recommend exponential backoff with jitter.
   - Ticket: DEVX-927 (linked).

2) Add a minimal TypeScript sample app: chat-with-qa-bot
   - Goals: show streaming messages, function calling example, and reconnect fallback to lower-cost model.
   - Files: index.ts, README.md, .env.sample (API_KEY, MODEL_ALIAS)
   - Time estimate: 3-4h if we cut scope (no frontend, node-only).

3) Python quickstart tutorial: fix env var naming mismatch
   - Issue: docs use REDWOOD_API_KEY while SDK env loader expects REDWOOD_KEY. Confusing.
   - Decision: align docs to REDWOOD_API_KEY, update loader, add deprecation warning in code for one release.

Doc gaps observed (notes from triage of recent questions):
- Missing explicit advice on when to use 'pin_version' vs 'model_hint' — add a one-paragraph decision table.
- No example of batching embeddings across mixed-length inputs. Need small snippet showing pad/truncate strategy + cost estimate.
- Rollout examples: current console screenshots are stale (v0.9 UI). Capture new flows or add note: "Console UI subject to change, see API for canonical examples."
- Error codes table: add mapping of runtime error -> likely cause + first action (e.g., INVALID_PROMPT -> truncate or raise model max length).

Sample apps to author (rough MVP list):
- chat-with-qa-bot (node ts) -> demonstrates streaming + function calling + fallback routing.
- embeddings-pipeline-demo (python) -> read CSV, batch embeddings, store to sqlite, basic nearest-neighbor query.
- rerank-demo (node) -> show generation + reranking using model X then scoring via embeddings model Y.

Tutorial fixes / micro PRs to open:
- PR A: README streaming example (JS) - add client.on('error') and mention reconnect strategy. (small)
- PR B: Python quickstart env var + loader change -> include deprecation warning log. (small, test needed)
- PR C: Add new "Pin vs Hint" doc snippet in SDK reference. (medium)
- PR D: Add embeddings batching snippet + cost footnote. (small)

Support recurring questions to address in FAQ snippet:
- "Why did my inference slow down after enabling caching?" -> explain prefix cache priming + cold cache impact.
- "How to pick quantized model vs cpu fallback?" -> add rule-of-thumb bullets.

Open questions / decisions I need help on:
- Should the node sample app include a tiny express server to demo streaming to browser? Pros: more hands-on. Cons: scope creep, maintenance. Recommendation: keep node-only CLI first, add express as follow-up.
- Naming env var canonical: REDWOOD_API_KEY or REDWOOD_KEY? I prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY. Ask @Priya to confirm backward compat policy.

Quick TODO (me, today):
- [ ] Draft PR for JS streaming README example (30-60m)
- [ ] Create TS skeleton for chat-with-qa-bot in /examples (2h)
- [ ] Update Python quickstart doc to use REDWOOD_API_KEY and open loader change RFC (45m)
- [ ] Add small note in SDK reference about 'pin_version' vs 'model_hint' (20m)
- [ ] Add one-line FAQ entry about cache cold-starts to support/shared-faq.md (10m)

Notes to self (random):
- Keep examples minimal: limit external deps (use fetch or node native where possible).
- Add CI smoke test for examples: run quick sample generation with MOCK_API_KEY and capture expected keys (very small).
- Remember: include provenance comment in examples: "Do not leak prod keys" and .env.sample file.

Slack threads / links to drop in PR descriptions:
- #devx-samples convo from 2026-03-09 (screenshot)
- PR to reference: github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/463 (example that inspired change)

End-of-day plan: ship PR A + create example folder with skeleton for chat app. If blocked on API naming, ping Priya and Alex by EOD.

----
Scratchy extras (for later):
- Quick code sketch for JS streaming error handling (paste here to copy into PR):
  const stream = await client.streamComplete({ model: 'rwd/fast-1', prompt });
  stream.on('data', chunk => process.stdout.write(chunk.text));
  stream.on('error', err => {
    console.error('stream error', err);
    // fallback: retry once with cheaper model or non-stream path
  });

- Small checklist for README examples: auth, minimal usage, error handling, config options, link to console.

Random note: product asked for a tiny "cost estimate" widget in sample READMEs (tokens->$). Might be a follow-up module. Keep placeholder.
